purpose: Establish a full-budget, capacity-matched P4 baseline before RC-PSCR-MAPPO is trained.
decision_rule: G1 passes if at least two independently trained seeds achieve nonzero primary and future completion across the reliability-stratified endpoint. This is a learnability gate only; it does not establish reliability use or RC-PSCR-MAPPO superiority.
next_authorized_action_if_pass: Implement the pre-registered RC-PSCR-MAPPO and its phase-aware and reliability-permuted controls for M1.
interpretation_boundary: G1 is a fresh development calibration. It will not be pooled with any future formal method cohort.
